audit.whatIsWrong: Chart gave Ornn Levels 2, 3 and 2+ items and only Skill at 4-5 and 6, while whys[1] says Warwick wins level 2 and whys[6] says he reclaims the late duel.
audit.why: Packet chart and prose agree on Warwick at row 1, contested at row 2, Ornn rows 3-5, Warwick at 2+ items; the stored chart matched neither.
audit.corrected: Rows 1,2,3,4,6 realigned in both layers with ratings to match.

audit.why: Spikes cover Level 3 W, Level 6 R, first item and the late scaling flip — all four present.

audit.whatIsWrong: The decisive interaction was never stated: Ornn's Volcanic Rupture (Q) grounds, and both of Warwick's engages are dashes.
audit.why: Jaws of the Beast (Q, 8/7.5/7/6.5/6s, 365 range) is a lunge and Infinite Duress (R, 110/90/70s) is a leap — both carry the dash flag, and Ornn's Q carries grounding. Primal Howl (E, 15/14/13/12/11s) gives 2.5s damage reduction then a 1s flee, and was never mentioned at all. Eternal Hunger heals him below 50% health and triples that healing below 25%, which is what makes anti-heal timing matter.
audit.corrected: Stated the grounding denial of both dashes, added Primal Howl's real numbers, and tied Grievous Wounds to the passive threshold.

audit.whatIsWrong: Packet flagged zero sequencing cues — no 'wait for X before Y' anywhere.
audit.why: Infinite Duress at 110s rank 1 is the punishable window; Primal Howl at 15s is the shorter one that ruins a bad engage.
audit.corrected: Rewrote the cooldown breakdown and dos entries with concrete numbers and ordering.

audit.why: Anti-heal is already core in report[8].t. Worth noting Jaws of the Beast deals max-health damage, so raw armour stacking is not the counter.

edits.before: - Warwick Infinite Duress: matchup-defining — His all-in suppress. E-knock up around it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Infinite Duress (R): 110s at rank 1 — it is a leap, so your Q pillar's grounding shuts it off. - Primal Howl (E): 15s, 2.5s damage reduction then a 1s flee. - Jaws of the Beast (Q): 8s lunge, grounded the same way.

edits.before: Track Warwick's Infinite Duress: His all-in suppress. E-knock up around it. When it is down — W-E + R him.
edits.after: Infinite Duress is a leap and Jaws of the Beast a lunge — Volcanic Rupture grounds both, so hold Q for his commit.

edits.before: His all-in suppress. E-knock up around it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: R is 110s at rank 1 and it is a leap — your Q grounding cancels the engage.

edits.before: Warwick wastes Infinite Duress — commit the full pattern immediately.
edits.after: R spent — 110 seconds without an engage, so run the pattern now.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Eternal Hunger triples his healing under 25% — bring Grievous Wounds.

edits.after: Bellows Breath goes up on a 12s cooldown — Brittle finally lets your autos trade back through his drain.

edits.before: R double knock-up plus your E-Q stun chains CC through his R suppress and wins the all-in.
edits.after: Your Q pillar grounds Infinite Duress, and R's knock-up finishes the all-in he wanted at 6.

notes: Whether a knock-up breaks Infinite Duress's suppression once it has landed is not answerable from the kit files, so no claim about interrupting it was written — the advice is built on grounding the leap before it starts, which the flags do support. Ornn's E knockup landing during the suppression is left unstated; flagged as unverified.
